text: Figure C. Two of the three metrics this project has quoted can be bought without finding anything. The shipped mask on the same 26 tiles from 13 specimens is grown outward at a continuous radius — bisected so the achieved area ratio lands on the requested one — and rescored at 0 px tolerance. At 1.5x area, clDice rises on every specimen (paired median +0.0189, 12 up / 1 down, p=0.0005) while skeleton-F1 at 2 px does not move (-0.0018, 5 up / 8 down, p=0.2439). IoU is the case that depends on how it is read: the tile median rises from 0.4189 to 0.4988, but paired over the 13 specimens it falls (-0.0226, 5 up / 8 down, p=0.7354), so IoU is gameable in the tile-median reading and not in the paired one. Growth by whole dilation steps, the spelling used elsewhere in this project, overshoots 1.5x by about 16% and is recorded separately in the data file.
